summary: OceanaGold Corp filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, announcing a definitive scheme implementation deed to acquire 100% of Ausgold Limited, owner of the Katanning Gold Project in Western Australia, via an Australian court-approved scheme of arrangement. Ausgold shareholders receive 0.03365 OceanaGold shares per Ausgold share, implying A$1.36 per share and total equity value of approximately A$776M (US$549M), with a cash alternative subject to a A$194M cap. Ausgold's board unanimously recommends the scheme, holding 1.4%, and Dundee Corporation (7.7%) supports it. Completion expected with regulatory and shareholder approval; watch for scheme meeting timing and premium realization.
